instrument NEAT_TOF_Spectrometer {
  // Instrument parameters
  double lambda = 6;
  double dlambda = 0.05;
  double rpm = 10000;
  string coh = "Rb_liq_coh.sqw";

  double tmin = 0.01806;
  double tmax = 0.01826;
  int seed = 123456;

  const double K2V = 3956.0; // m/s per 1/Å
  const double VS2E = 0.5 * 1.0 / (3956.0 * 3956.0); // meV per (m/s)^2

  // Derived quantities
  double Chopper2Detector = 11.97 + 2.143 + 0.165;
  double KI = 2 * M_PI / lambda;
  double Vi = K2V * fabs(KI);
  double EI = VS2E * Vi * Vi;
  double time_elastic = 252.78 * Chopper2Detector * lambda * 1e-6;
  double Emin = EI - 20;
  if (Emin < EI / 3) Emin = EI / 3;
  double Emax = EI + 20;
  double Vmin = sqrt(Emin / VS2E);
  double Vmax = sqrt(Emax / VS2E);
  double Tmin = 2.5 / Vmax;
  double Tmax = 2.5 / Vmin;

  // Monitor options
  string lmon_options = sprintf("lambda limits=[%g %g] bins=100", lambda - dlambda / 2.0, lambda + dlambda / 2.0);
  string tmon_options = sprintf("tof limits=[%g %g] bins=100", tmin, tmax);
  string detector_options = sprintf("banana, abs angle limits=[13 136] bins=300, time limits=[%g %g] bins=256", time_elastic + Tmin, time_elastic + Tmax);

  // Components
  PG: Progress_bar AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE;

  Source: Source_gen AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters

      focus_xw = 0.03,
      focus_yh = 0.055,

      dlambda = dlambda,
      I1 = 1.4e12,
      T1 = 43.7,
      I2 = 2.08e12,
      T2 = 137.2;

    parameters
      w1 = 0.03,

      l = 2,
      m = 1.2;

    parameters

  Guide_CGS: Guide_gravity AT (0, 0, 2.352) RELATIVE Guide_SGS3 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    parameters

    parameters

    parameters

  Guide_time: Monitor_nD AT (0, 0, 1.2e-2 / 2) RELATIVE Chopper6 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters

      options = detector_options;

    parameters

      zdepth = 0.01,
